mapper.select: SELECT t1.C_01 AS c01 , t1.C_02 AS c02 , t1.C_03 AS c03 , t1.C_04 AS c04 , t1.C_05 AS c05 , SUM(t1.N_01) AS n01 , SUM(t1.N_02) AS n02 , CASE WHEN t1.C_01 = 'GA191' THEN MAX(t1.N_03) ELSE SUM(t1.N_03) END AS n03 , SUM(t1.N_04) AS n04 , SUM(t1.N_05) AS n05 , SUM(t1.N_06) AS n06 , SUM(t1.N_07) AS n07 , SUM(t1.N_08) AS n08 , SUM(t1.N_09) AS n09 , SUM(t1.N_10) AS n10 , SUM(t1.N_11) AS n11 , SUM(t1.N_12) AS n12 , SUM(t1.N_13) AS n13 , SUM(t1.N_14) AS n14 , SUM(t1.N_15) AS n15 , SUM(t1.N_16) AS n16 , SUM(t1.N_17) AS n17 , SUM(t1.N_18) AS n18 , SUM(t1.N_19) AS n19 , SUM(t1.N_20) AS n20 FROM GA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YM = #{ym} GROUP BY t1.C_01, t1.C_02, t1.C_03, t1.C_04, t1.C_05 ORDER BY t1.C_01, t1.C_02, t1.C_03

SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , t1.C_01 AS c01 , t1.C_02 AS c02 , t1.C_03 AS c03 , t1.C_04 AS c04 , t1.C_05 AS c05 , t1.N_03 AS n03 , SUM(t1.N_01) AS n01 , SUM(t1.N_02) AS n02 FROM GA t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YM = #{ym} AND t1.C_01 = 'GA191' GROUP BY t1.FUND_CD, ia.FUND_NM, t1.C_01, t1.C_02, t1.C_03, t1.C_04, t1.C_05, t1.N_03 ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD, t1.C_02, t1.N_03
